mapper.sql: p.wo_proc_id, p.wo_id, p.op_seq, p.proc_cd, p.proc_nm, p.status, p.row_ver, w.status as wo_status, w.plant_cd, w.unit_cd, q.good, q.scrap, q.rework, q.repair, q.rework_done, q.repair_done, q.disp_good, q.disp_scrap, p.equip_id, p.proc_id, w.item_id from prd_wo_proc p join prd_wo w on w.wo_id = p.wo_id cross join lateral hb_proc_qty(p.wo_proc_id) q
mapper.select: select where p.wo_id = #{woId} and p.op_seq < #{opSeq} order by p.op_seq desc limit 1
select r.lot_id from prd_result r where r.wo_proc_id = #{id} and r.lot_id is not null union select k.lot_id from prd_rework k where k.wo_proc_id = #{id} and k.lot_id is not null order by 1

select count(*) from lot_master m where m.hold_yn = 'Y' and m.lot_id in (select r.lot_id from prd_result r where r.wo_proc_id = #{id} and r.lot_id is not null union select k.lot_id from prd_rework k where k.wo_proc_id = #{id} and k.lot_id is not null)
select status from prd_wo_proc where wo_proc_id = #{id} for update
mapper.insert: insert into prd_wo_proc_close (comp_cd, wo_id, wo_proc_id, input_qty, good_qty, scrap_qty, rework_qty, repair_qty, eff_good_qty, diff_qty, tol_pct, first_op_yn, remark, occurred_at, entry_method, recorded_by) values (hb_current_comp(), #{f.woId}, #{f.woProcId}, #{f.inputQty}, #{f.goodQty}, #{f.scrapQty}, #{f.reworkQty}, #{f.repairQty}, #{f.effGoodQty}, #{f.diffQty}, #{f.tolPct}, #{f.firstOpYn}, #{f.remark}, #{at}, 'KEY', #{by})
mapper.update: update prd_wo_proc set status = 'DONE', row_ver = row_ver + 1, updated_at = now(), updated_by = #{by} where wo_proc_id = #{id} and status = 'READY' and row_ver = #{rowVer}
mapper.select: insert into prd_rework (comp_cd, wo_id, wo_proc_id, kind, qty, good_qty, scrap_qty, unit_cd, lot_id, reason, client_req_id, occurred_at, entry_method, recorded_by) values (hb_current_comp(), #{f.woId}, #{f.woProcId}, #{f.kind}, #{f.qty}, #{f.goodQty}, #{f.scrapQty}, #{f.unitCd}, #{f.lotId}, #{f.reason}, #{f.clientReqId}, #{at}, 'KEY', #{by}) returning rework_id
select count(*) from prd_wo_proc where wo_id = #{woId} and status <> 'DONE'
mapper.update: update prd_wo set status = 'DONE', done_at = #{doneAt}, row_ver = row_ver + 1, updated_at = now(), updated_by = #{by} where wo_id = #{woId} and status = 'IN_PROGRESS' and row_ver = #{rowVer}
update prd_wo set status = 'CLOSED', row_ver = row_ver + 1, updated_at = now(), updated_by = #{by} where wo_id = #{woId} and status = 'DONE' and row_ver = #{rowVer}
mapper.select: select coalesce(sum(qty), 0) from prd_receipt where wo_id = #{woId}
